description: This file defines the HTMLActuator class responsible for updating the game UI elements such as tiles, score, and messages in a 2048-like game.

classes.name: HTMLActuator
classes.description: A class responsible for updating the game display, including tiles, scores, and messages.

methods.name: actuate
methods.description: Updates the game UI based on the current grid and game metadata, including rendering tiles and showing win/lose messages.

methods.name: continueGame
methods.description: Clears game messages to continue or restart the game.

methods.name: clearContainer
methods.description: Removes all child elements from a given container element.

methods.name: addTile
methods.description: Creates and adds a tile element to the game board, handling positioning, merging, and styling.

methods.name: applyClasses
methods.description: Sets the class attribute of an element based on a list of classes.

methods.name: normalizePosition
methods.description: Converts a tile's position to a normalized coordinate system.

methods.name: positionClass
methods.description: Returns a CSS class name for a tile's position.

methods.name: updateScore
methods.description: Updates the score display and shows score increase animations.

methods.name: updateBestScore
methods.description: Updates the display of the best score.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Displays a win or game over message based on game state.

methods.name: clearMessage
methods.description: Removes game over or win messages from the display.
